$comment: NEGATIVE fixture for J1.4: a bond directly joins an Electrical port (Ground1.p) and a Rotation port (FixShaft.a). Both ports are concrete, so the editor would refuse the bond, and the compiler reports E102 (a bond needs a Generic port or a junction) on node n2 / connection c1. The second scenario the WP lists (a bond to a rotation port from an electrical port) is exactly this one.
name: NegBondCrossDomain
